in_marathi.name: Nivvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nivvansh means 'new lineage' or 'new generation'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'niv' meaning 'new' and 'vansh' meaning 'lineage' or 'generation'. It is a powerful name that signifies the beginning of a new era or the emergence of a new family line. In Hindu mythology, Nivvansh is also associated with the god Vishnu, who is believed to preserve and protect the universe and create new forms of life.
